## New theme checklist

Delete this section if the pull request doesn't add a theme.

- [ ] Source image is public domain, CC0, CC BY or my own photo. Licence page: <!-- link -->
- [ ] `CREDITS.md` entry added (source, licence, link, changes, my name)
- [ ] The art file's header names the source and licence
- [ ] One row, with the screenshot, added to the Themes table in `README.md`
- [ ] Both SVGs are under 131,072 characters
- [ ] `claude plugin validate plugins/itihasa` and `claude plugin test plugins/itihasa` pass
- [ ] Tried still and motion in the desktop app; the motion moves there, not only in a browser
- [ ] Screenshot added at `docs/screenshots/<id>.jpg`
